definitions.explanation: A pen with an internal reservoir of ink.

notes:
{万年筆|まんねんひつ} literally means "ten-thousand-year brush," implying durability.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{万年|まんねん}→万年：28146_mannen⟧: ten thousand years (long-lasting)
- ⟦{筆|ひつ}→筆：03601_fude⟧: writing brush/pen

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {万年筆|まんねんひつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write with a fountain pen
- {万年筆|まんねんひつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦インク→インク：00120_inku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to fill with ink

RELATED WRITING TOOLS:
- ⟦ボールペン→ボールペン：00691_boorupen⟧: ballpoint pen
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧: pencil
- ⟦シャープペンシル→シャープペンシル：23768_shaapupenshiru⟧: mechanical pencil
- ⟦{筆|ふで}ペン→筆ペン：27998_fudepen⟧: brush pen

USAGE:
{万年筆|まんねんひつ} is often used for formal documents, signatures, and as luxury gifts. High-quality Japanese brands like Pilot and Sailor are internationally renowned.
